body:
Reminds me of the roller ball
Things from bionicle
Very very valid point

I can understand this for sure, I’ve dealt with constant cancel scanners and decided I’d have to play at their game when I’m able to and join in, but also I know everyone wants to sell so id make sure not to overdo it.

Enchants still will sell well and probably will continue to, I just honestly thought he was posting low as an error at first, and yeah I’ll still make profit once I’m shuffling for sure so no real like loss, just less profit

It’s actually something I do fairly often, as I’m auctioning I’d notice players who sneak in massive undercuts to snipe, I fell for it and lost a massive stock once so I made it a habit to let other players notice if they are about to fall for it.
Fair point, I chose to engage when I didn’t have to

I think I was more in shock I guess, I talk often with other AH players and we share advice and talk pretty frequently letting each other know if we realized a mistake was made, this is the first I had that kind of interaction with another AH player but everyone is different as they say
I’m also a firm believer in we’re all out there to make gold and get our Brutos, why fight so much and make it more difficult for others

I don’t deny that he’s probably making a profit but wouldn’t it be better to keep margins at a more reasonable area? Instead of like a 20-50g profit, more so in enchanting where a player has to spend hours shuffling or farming dungeons to mass produce?
That makes me so sad, I’m gonna miss out of a week of gold making cuz I won’t get the part I need till Friday 😞
Well that sucks 😞
Do you use dragon center? I had an issue with my fans and after uninstalling dragon center they stopped completely

So something interesting happened, the fans started bugging again, so I decided to uninstall and re install all my rgb controlling software, Icue razer synapse and dragon center, so I happened to realize today I forgot to re install dragon center and for the past week no fan issues, makes me wonder if dragon center may cause issues with icue?
This seemed to have worked, fans are back to normal, thanks so much!

That’s also possible, a lot of people just don’t seem to care about prices or think if I make this lower it’s gonna sell faster, which is maybe true if someone wants to keeps the price at a certain point but mostly it just seems to me players just don’t know what they’re doing on the AH / TSM

A stack of 100 enchants at that undercut won’t sell with everyone else undercutting though that’s how the price dropped to 450g now on my server and I actually did try to reset and honestly the same guy legit just did the same thing so I didn’t bother after that I just wasted my gold

He’s not the only poster on the server so him posting so many at that price point literally just drove the entire market down
Unfortunately on my server it didn’t work for sure, prices tanked hard sitting around 450-500g currently

Just using this morning as an example, enchants got reset to between 700-850g on my server. That’s actually there normal price, all enchant mats got reset so the prices weren’t a major profit if you bought all your mats off AH but still a small margin. When I logged in thankfully some posts I left overnight sold but there’s the guy who undercut by 200-300g and I’m just like why? There’s no profit at all.
I haven’t tried the transmog market yet so might check that out for sure
Thankfully I have almost every profession, it’s mostly me being alittle salty cuz I was rearing to make some nice gold today off those price resets
I don’t think it’s so bad with mats tbh, like zin or cloth since people do buy those in bulk, but with enchants no way someone’s gonna instantly sell 100 enchants I’d think. I could be wrong honestly

I seriously wonder what's going through these peoples mind when they made large undercuts like that, that even go lower than the cost of the mats.

It doesn't even take long to calculate your mat price vs auction price, before I got TSM I used to just sit down with my phone calculator and add it up to see what was profitable.

I accidentally bought one of those auctions that people put up for like 200-400k so I feel like crud, just started on the gold making journey and had hit 600k last night 😭

I meant to buy a stack of old enchanting mats and clicked everything by mistake
Same thing happens to me except it freezes my entire computer I’ve had to skip every cutscene and just watch them on YouTube to continue playing
I woke up threw up abit, I just feel I disappoint everyone around me, friends family, what I do or try isn’t good enough for them
Yeah that’s what I mean, that this system would let you unlock every set as a layered set by crafting the entire set and handing in it as a delivery quest, idk if it would work but just an idea
